final: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS standing_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(standing_count) AS value FROM counts) SELECT counts.constructorId, counts.nationality, counts.standing_count, counts.standing_count - average_count.value FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE average_count.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY counts.standing_count - average_count.value DESC LIMIT 10
